title: 'Tic-tac' leaves as soon as he heads for the helicopter

tellings.quote: I take 10 steps, and " "Tic-tac" begins to fly away.

plain: In 2025, on a hill at a field site, a "tic-tac" (a white oval object shaped like the mint) flew off the moment he started walking toward a helicopter, says a member of Skywatcher, a startup that says it is trying to call up UFOs. He tells it as his own experience: "I take 10 steps, and 'Tic-tac' begins to fly away." If true, it would suggest the object was reacting to what the team on the ground did.
